1. When I paint the rectangle with a color, the square's top half changes to that color (and the bottom half becomes the opposite or complementary color)
2. When I press SPACE, the square either splits (if rectangle is purple) or merges (if rectangle is white)
So the sequence is:
- Paint rectangle purple → square becomes purple-over-white (top purple, bottom white)
- Paint rectangle white → square becomes white-over-purple (top white, bottom purple)
- Press SPACE with rectangle purple → square stays purple-over-white (or splits if it was solid)
- Press SPACE with rectangle white → square becomes solid white (merges)
